n: Buy buttons you can't afford yet show how long until you can, like "in 42s". Upgrades show it too when you tap them
The Prestige screen says how long until you can reset. Once you can, it shows how much you're earning per minute, so you can tell when it's worth resetting
On small phones like the iPhone SE, currencies sit in one row you can swipe, so the top bar takes less room
Fixed: the upgrade tree's "owned" count was hard to read over the tree
